_note: Per-gate blocking flag. A gate BLOCKS completion only when blocking=true. Promote a heuristic gate to blocking ONLY after scripts/calibrate.py shows, over the full golden set (PASS + FAIL): false_positives=0, catches all its FAIL cases, low_confidence<10%. Promote per gate, never as a group. Robust gates ship blocking; pixel-geometry heuristics start advisory. Pairwise angle separation (docs/12) is always enforced separately in run_catalog, independent of the single-shot G10_ANGLE flag below.

G10_ANGLE.measures: every slot a genuinely different camera angle; NO duplicate angles delivered. A retry REPLACES its slot, never ships alongside it (e.g. never 04_gallery_back AND 04_gallery_back_2).
G10_ANGLE.note: Blocking 2026-08-01 (CATALOG STANDARD). Pairwise angle separation also enforced in run_catalog.

G12_MARKS.measures: ZERO TOLERANCE for third-party/vendor watermark and any burned-in mark. Scan every render for: semi-transparent glyph clusters anywhere in frame, low-contrast repeated text, engraved marks/hallmark/karat-stamp/initials on metal surfaces, corner logo/badge. Any hit = FAIL -> auto-regenerate. A watermarked render is NEVER delivered.
G12_MARKS.note: CATALOG-BLOCKING (raised 2026-08-01). Vendor source watermark (e.g. CRYSTALIGHT, MoonlitCharms) must never appear on jewellery/skin/background, not faint/partial/stylised. Only permitted mark = official Lucent logo printed into studio cloth from the locked asset (never on metal/skin/lifestyle). Full negative block wired into build_prompts.

G15_HAND_ANATOMY.measures: ring on ONE finger; band continuity; position
G15_HAND_ANATOMY.note: OBSERVED (demoted from blocking 2026-07-30): false-rejected verified-good LR-0205 slot07 (two clasped hands read as one -> mis-assigned finger). MediaPipe finger assignment unreliable on overlapping/partial hands. Re-promote only after FP=0 on the LR-0205/0206 golden set. Single-hand placement still measured + reported.

G16_SKIN_REALISM.note: OBSERVED (demoted from blocking 2026-07-30): false-rejected verified-good soft beauty-crop skin (LR-0205 slot09=64); normalized-HF cannot cleanly separate soft-focus from waxy. Threshold 45 for advisory signal. Re-promote only after FP=0 on a labelled soft-vs-waxy golden set.

G_INVENT.measures: studio angle traces to a source view within 45deg
G_INVENT.note: No source view within 45deg (az+el) of a studio slot = invention, blocked. Source angles in specs/<SKU>_views.json. Lifestyle exempt.

G17_THEME.note: Catalog-level: 6 lifestyle renders cluster in hue+luma (a=consistency); catalog palette differs from last 6 (b=distinctness); banned wardrobe prompt-enforced (c).

G18_BACKGROUND.measures: studio background is plain pure-white velvet (low sat, high lum, fine mid-freq fabric texture)
G18_BACKGROUND.note: Studio slots only. Rejects coloured backgrounds (sat/chan), seamless paper (texture<min), hard gradients/sweeps (gradient), busy props (texture>max). Calibrated on 7 approved velvet renders (sat<=6.1, lum>=227, grad<=0.144, tex 0.76-1.64, chan<=0.022) -> FP=0 with wide margin. Golden: LR-0205 studio.

G20_MIN_SUBJECT_SCALE.measures: jewellery bbox area fraction: lifestyle >=20%, macro >=35%; below = auto-reject before geometry. Min 3 of 6 lifestyle slots must be tight macro (ring dominates, hand cropped, pure bokeh).
G20_MIN_SUBJECT_SCALE.note: Raised 2026-08-01 (CATALOG STANDARD). Faces not required — crop a face that pulls attention. Banned framings: full hand at arm's length, both hands wide, torso, environment establishing, ring as a sliver.

G21_STONE_RATIO.measures: per-stone areas -> centre:flanker size ratio within +/-10% of spec, and stone COUNT per shape class == spec
G21_STONE_RATIO.note: ADVISORY: the engine cannot hold stone ratios; logs to file, does not gate.

G22_STONE_WITHIN_FINGER.measures: lifestyle: centre-stone width <= finger width (× tol); rejects oversized 'cocktail-huge' diamonds on the hand

G23_MAKES_SENSE.measures: jewellery is wearable as rendered. Bracelet/necklace/anklet: exactly ONE clasp (one lobster/spring-ring/toggle-bar at one end; opposite end = jump ring / closed loop / extender ending in a drop, never a second claw). Two identical fastening mechanisms = FAIL 'unfastenable, two claws' -> auto-regenerate. Rings: closed single shank. Earrings: one post/hook each. Pendants: one bail, chain passes through.
G23_MAKES_SENSE.note: PERMANENT (CATALOG STANDARD). BR-0110 rendered a lobster claw on both ends. Positive+negative clasp clauses wired into build_prompts for bracelet/necklace.

G24_CLARITY_CHECK.measures: every stone crystal-clear/water-clear: (a) per-stone mean luminance above threshold; (b) facet-edge sharpness = high-frequency energy inside each stone above threshold (soft/smeared = FAIL); (c) colour neutrality within a narrow neutral-white band (no yellow/grey cast); (d) consistency = no stone materially duller than its neighbours
G24_CLARITY_CHECK.note: PERMANENT all catalogs. Any fail = auto-regenerate. Lifestyle: ring must sit in direct light, not hand shadow (a shadowed stone fails regardless of prompt). Positive clarity clause + banned terms wired into build_prompts (all slots).
